strings.en: With singular resolve!!
Here I go!
Here I come!!
Straight at you, head-on!
Whoever stands in my way,/　I will cut them down!
By strength and will, I will defeat you!
Take my blow!
Every foe before me shall be shattered!
Prepare yourself!!
Whoever bars my path will be shattered!!
I shall pass through in my own style!
I'm going in!!
With a true blade, I shall force my way through!
With a blade of blinding speed, I carve a path to life!
Sänger Sombold, here I come!!
I am Sänger Sombold!/　The sword that cuts down evil!!
Grungust Type 0 has arrived!
Taste the power of the Type 0 firsthand!
You cannot stop the Type-0!
A sword that cleaves warships... That is the Zankanto!
Learn the name of the Zankanto with your own body!
Grungust Type 3 has arrived!!
Taste the power of the Type 3 firsthand!!
With this Type 3, I challenge you!!
You cannot stop the Type-3!
Type 1 has arrived!
Withstand the Super Fighter's power!!
Type 2 has arrived!!
Here we go, Type 2!!
Dygenguar has arrived!
Armored War God Dygenguar has arrived!
The Armored War God has arrived!
You cannot stop/　this Dygenguar!
Here we go, Dygenguar!
Taste the power of the Armored War God/　firsthand!!
Gu-Landon Gortz.../　Dygenguar shall guide you to the road of death!
The Earth Sphere is no marketplace for you!
Vanguard of the Golaikunru, perish far from home!
Do you have the nerve to trade lives with me?!
So-Des, you deserve no mercy!
Do you have the spirit to face me in a fair fight?!
Jua-Mu Dalubi! Face me fairly!
Jua-Mu.../　However great your stubbornness may be!
Jua-Mu.../　Your obsession cannot warp my belief!
My sword shall dispel your delusions!
Knight of the Fury,/　do not think you can parry my sword!
A true duel between samurai and knight is my wish!
Al-Van Ranks... Face me head-on!
Al-Van Ranks.../　A worthy opponent!
Fu-Ruu Muru! Face me fairly!
My sword shall cut open a path for the Granteed!
Neither of us has a way back... Here I come, Fu-Ruu!
Karo-Ran! Your wicked ambitions end here!
My sword shall cut your schemes to pieces!
Gu-Landon Gortz.../　There is no throne for you to sit upon!
Gu-Landon!/　Those who drown in their ambitions only fall to ruin!
Know that my sword cannot be measured on an abacus!
Money-worshipping mercenaries are no foes of mine!
Hear me! Stay out of the Earth Sphere's affairs!
Ringleader of the Golaikunru? Then I show no mercy!
I won't let you go further, Vort Nikolaus!
You cast away a warrior's pride/　to become a demon...!
I'm forcing my way through! Make way, Vort!
Reggiane, quench your bloodlust in the underworld!
Herluga's right hand is no match for the Zankanto!
Herluga! Your wicked ambitions shall be crushed!
The gate you pass through is not the Cross Gate,/　but the gate to the netherworld!
Bizarre clown... Face me fairly!
I shall pulverize this sandstone demon in an instant!
The Wicked Clown must be annihilated!
The Zankanto shall sweep away your sorcery!
If you are a puppet, I shall simply cut you down!
Whatever you may possess...!
Evil fluid must be dispelled!
Wooden puppets! I shall scatter you!
Have at you, Crystal Dragoon!
Time to slay a dragon! Here I come!
I shall shatter this crystal dragon!
I'll sever those wings!
Evil bone knight, face me fairly!
Here I come, Skull Knight!
I will not fall behind one who calls himself a knight!
I shall shatter that lance!
Lay your bones to rest here, quite literally!
XN-L, your deeds turn the natural order upside down!
If you are the giant who brought intelligence,/　I shall be the blade that brings death to the false god!
My name is Sänger! Sänger Sombold!/　The sword that cleaves the ancient false god!
No matter how you soar through the sky!
Here I come, Zovorg!
I shall scatter the Zovorg!
However many times you come, I shall drive you back!
Leave the Earth Sphere, Golaikunru!
I shall crush the puppets of the merchants of death!
The Earth Sphere is no market for you!
You shall go no further!
I shall strike down the commander's unit!
Strike down the commander's unit and seize victory!
Machine of the Fury, have at you!
I shall shatter the Fury unit before me!
No mercy for those who would/　plunge the Earth Sphere into chaos!
Fury... Whatever you may be plotting!
I shall cut you down, armor and all!
I shall hack off that horn!
Shady villains...!
I shall tear off your false mask!
I will not fall behind a Gadisword machine!
You stand in my way, Gadisword?!
Whatever your creed may be,/　if you turn your blades on us...!
Gadisword, what is it you truly seek?!
I shall be the wall here!
My sword shall shatter that giant scythe!
I shall shatter you, demon and all!
Ghouls and specters shall be destroyed!
I'll slay these demons on the spot!
Lamaris, begone!
Ghosts must be banished at once!
Scatter and perish, Lamaris!
I shall mow down the Lamaris!
I have no business with small fry like you!
I do not cower before spirits!
Whatever form you take, I shall scatter you!
With singular purpose! I cut down the malevolent entity!
Lamaris Kaana, be dispersed!
My sword shall slay this malevolence!
With my resolve, I shall destroy this great evil!
All shall fall before becoming the false brain's vessel!
You fell to the dark path and became a demon.
You return from the underworld, Ares Geist...!
My sword shall seal your movements!
I will not let you become the false brain's vessel!
Very well! I accept this challenge!!
Back at you!!
That's the spirit!!
No more words!!
Prepare to face the consequences!
Then here I come!!
You are still within my reach!
I shall cut down any who stand in my way in an instant!
I-I have failed...!!
Ngh.../　Adversity only spurs me on!!
To die as a warrior is all I ask!
I won't die alone!/　I'll drag you to hell with me!
Guh...! Well done...!!
Hmph! A fight worth staking my life on!
Nngh! I've been driven back!!
Guh!/　I cannot fall here!!
This strike...! You're no ordinary foe!
My sword and my resolve... will not break!
Only by overcoming hardship is a samurai honed!!
Gah!/　But the Type-3 has not fallen yet!!
Heavily damaged...!/　But the Grungust can still fight!
...One more swing is all I need...!
Nngh!/　Dygenguar, this is the moment of truth!!
Jua-Mu, you hold me back?!
Your obsession pushes me this far?!
I will not let the soulless do as they please!
Splendid, Al-Van Ranks!
Karo-Ran, this is not settled yet!
Gu-Landon... Do not underestimate my resolve!
Gomoudokka.../　Does ambition taken to its limit become belief?!
Vort, I have taken in your resolve... But!
Not yet! I will not let you drink my blood!
I must not let him draw out/　any more of the Cross Gate's power...!
Ngh! Was I misled by trickery?!
Clown, do not get carried away!
Quite literally, I let you cut my flesh to cut your bone!
False god...! That is not enough to break.../　the resolve of humanity, of me!
So even the Fury have one this skilled!
I must stop the Lamaris here!
The Ida's onslaught is not to be underestimated!
Ngh! I've fought this foe several times, but...!
Yes.../　Only with that Drive can you defeat me!!
Only a killing blow will mean anything!!
Pierce...?!/　Was there still carelessness in me...?!
That's not enough to take my life!!
You lack the strength to face me!
Guh! I was careless!!
So you dared step into my range...!
Do not think that will dull my spirit!
Impressive skill.../　But not enough against the Type-0!!
To inflict this much/　damage on the Type-3...!
To hold off both me/　and the Dygenguar!
Hold your ground, Dygenguar!
So-Des, I have no intention of indulging your pleasures!
He has turned his obsession into unyielding resolve!
Ngh! Al-Van.../　You surpass even my ability to predict!
That lady knight dares step into my reach!
Karo-Ran, you were waiting for this chance!
Whatever grand cause you raise,/　it is nothing but a pipe dream!
The title of Knight Commander is no mere ornament...!
That woman knows how to seize her chance...!
Gomoudokka, weapon specs alone cannot defeat me!
Ngh! Not bad, Vort Nikolaus!
That woman closes in so quickly...!
I must pull his machine away from the Cross Gate!
Falling into his trap... Was I careless...?!
That dragon's push is not to be underestimated!
Skull Knight, you match me blow for blow!
I have felt the power of the ancient giant!
I need no guidance from a false god!
Hmph, swarming to the bug light, are you?
They learned our blind spots in the last war...!
To be caught off guard by the Zovorg...!
Ngh, so they've studied us well...!
I must break the Fury's momentum here,/　and yet...!
Gadisword is not to be underestimated...!
Hmph! To let the Lamaris run rampant!
Ngh! To struggle against the Lamaris!
To be overpowered by the Lamaris!
That monstrosity... It is not to be underestimated!
Lamaris Ida, you would shake me?!
So you managed to hit me...!
No need to hold back!/　Come at me with everything you have!
Don't think a step that sloppy/　will be enough to defeat me!!
Mercy is unnecessary!!
Don't challenge me/　with half-hearted resolve!!
There's no need to hold anything back!!
Too shallow! Strike harder!
You lack resolve!!
Laughable!/　You challenge me with skill like that?!
You're far from defeating me!!
This hardly counts as a wound!
Have you not the resolve to give it your all?
That's not enough to down the Type-0!
That won't even scratch/　the Grungust!
You lack the Spirit to defeat the Type-3!
Not to soulless grunts!
Those without souls cannot strike me down!
Your tricks will not work on me!
Is that your resolve, Jua-Mu?!
Jua-Mu, you are lost in delusion!
A good strike, Al-Van Ranks!
Is this all a knight of the Fury amounts to?!
Fu-Ruu, there is no need to hold back!
I did not underestimate you for being a woman, but...!
An accurate attack, but shallow. What is he plotting?
A sword steeped in ambition cannot defeat me!
The resolve of a treacherous vassal amounts to this!
So his aim is to throw the battlefield into disarray.
I have taken your blow, Gomoudokka!
Is that all, Gomoudokka?!
Too shallow, Vort! Come at me with all you have!
Momentum alone cannot defeat me, Reggiane!
I doubt he can fully control that power...!
You wield the Cross Gate's power,/　and this is all?
Puppets are no match for me!
Clown, is your act over already?
What was that trick just now?
That dragon... It is faster than it looks.
Evil bone knight, is that lance just for show?!
XN-L,/　whatever mission you were given...!
XN-L! I need no indoctrination!
You have faced us before, yet you have not improved.
What is wrong? You should know our strength by now.
The power of a commander's unit? Laughable!
A mere number of cannons will not shake me.
Do not underestimate me, Fury!
The Gadisword machines' mobility is formidable.
I cannot shake off the Lamaris...
This is no time to play with ghosts...!
That Lamaris.../　Its size and power do not seem to match.
Its power has grown since last time...!
That weapon demands caution.
I've seen through it!
You're unworthy to face me!
Weak! Far too weak!!
You're no match!!
Pathetic!
Begone!
You'll never catch up to the Grungust!
Don't underestimate the Type-3's speed!
You're no match for Dygenguar!
You think that will shake men's hearts? Laughable!
What is wrong, Jua-Mu?!
I will not fall behind a knight of the Fury!
I see through you, Karo-Ran!
What is wrong?/　Is that all the Emperor's unit can do?!
I shall give you no chance to possess me!
Do not think you can indoctrinate me!
I know your tricks!
It moves better than known Zovorg units, but...
The Lamaris are no match for me!
It is nothing but a mass of congealed ghosts.
I do not cower before a great evil!
Yokijin are no match for me!
The powerless should leave!
Your training is lacking!!
Come back when you're ready!!
Not enough!
If you are afraid, you will never reach me!
You lack the strength to stand before me!
Too green, Jua-Mu Dalubi!
Those clouded eyes cannot catch me!
Show me your full strength, Al-Van Ranks!
You seem to have doubts, Fu-Ruu!
Your glib manner will not fool me, Iradoya!
Is that the extent of your resolve, Vort?!
If you would draw my blood,/　come at me with everything!
Whatever arts you unleash, it is futile.
XN-L! That giant body cannot catch me!
Crystal Dragon, you misjudged my strength.
Skull Knight, are your eyes hollow?!
You shall not pass!
However you lay your barrage, it is futile!
No Fury machine can stop me.
Hardly different from Zovorg weapons.
Your scythe will not reach me!
Can mere spite surpass my drive?
I will not fall behind a mere spirit.
No matter how much you swell, you cannot beat me!
Even with those wings, you cannot touch me!
That won't work!!
Hrmmm!!
Useless!!
Your spirit is lacking!!
Out of options...!
Tactics like that can't defeat me!
Hm! You've read my range.
I'll lend a hand!
I won't miss that opening!!
I can still press in!!
An opening!
I shall drive the blade in!
You called, Kyosuke Nanbu?!
Kyosuke! I'll finish this!
Excellen! You're too careless!
Fall back, Excellen!
Good attack, Brooklyn!
I'll lend a hand, Brooklyn!
Leave the rest to me, Gilliam.
I know what must be done!
Major Kai! Allow me to assist!
This timing... Just like old times, my friend!
Rätsel! I'll take it from here!
You called, Rätsel?!
Arado! Keep up the assault!
Sensei, I'll lend a hand!
Yuuki, leave the rest to me!
Good move, Yuuki!
Lilcarla, I'll take it from here!
Don't get distracted, Lilcarla!
Raul, leave the rest to me!
Raul! Go on ahead!
Fiona, I've got the rest!
I'll lend a hand, Fighter Roar!
Your momentum burns like fire!
Joshua, leave the rest to me!
I'll lend a hand, Cliana!
Hugo, I'll take it from here!
Aqua, leave the rest to me!
I'll lend you a hand, Arieil!
Ing, I'll lend a hand!
Your strikes lack force, Touma!
You're too careless, Michiru!
I shall lend you my sword, Touya Shiun!
Your finish is careless, Calvina Coulange!
One sword does not fight alone!
Yon Gebana, leave the rest to me!
Sieg, go on ahead!
Sally, I shall take it from here!
Is that your full strength, Haken Browning?!
Al-Van! I shall strike from this side too!
My Zankanto, too, is a sword of the soul!
This battle isn't over yet!!
I'll take this fight!!
I'll be your shield!!
Careless, Kyosuke!
Excellen! Out of the way!
Fall back, Brooklyn!
Withdraw, Gilliam!
Major Kai, fall back at once!
Rätsel, leave this fight to me!
Fall back, Rätsel!
Arado! This is beyond you!
Sensei, leave this to me!
Fall back, Yuuki!
Stay sharp, Rilkarla!
Withdraw, Raul!
Fall back, Fiona!
Don't let your guard down, Fighter Roar!
Fall back, Touma!
Careless, Michiru!
Keep your eyes on the enemy, Touya Shiun!
Fall back for now, Calvina!
I will not let the sword of the soul be broken!
You are being targeted, Haken!
Al-Van, leave this to me!
By the Three Kills, I shall strike you down!
I won't let this chance slip!
My sword can still reach you!
Know that none can resist the armored war god!
Assault, and nothing else!
Take this!!
There!!

Be blown away!!
Maxi Blaster!

Chestoooooo!!

My friend, now we show them our power!

Engaging!

Here I come!!
